name: upli_connection_side
description: One side of the synchronous UPLI connection handshake; Common 2.0 sections 4.1-4.3.

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: User authorized full UALink RTL implementation and local Verilator/Yosys/OpenSTA. Agent derives this bounded native UPLI module contract from the audited normative/model contract; individual port spelling is an implementation decision, not a separately user-approved standard encoding.

behavior: Three registered bits per side: post-reset guard, request and acknowledge.
First deassertion edge remains quiet; request earliest at following edge.
Ack consumes the prior peer request; request/ack remain asserted until reset.
Only Completer may optionally wait for peer direction completion.
Connected flags do not include credits or imply permission to gate clocks.
constraints: Use synthesizable Verilog-2001 and all RTL-MD MUST rules.
Native UPLI handshake is not replaced with AXI.
One register per synchronous always block; no gated clocks, inferred latches or CDC.
Project snake_case module naming; Chinese same-line semantic comments.
notes: Skill default simulator/remote ordering overridden by explicit local Verilator selection.
Whole skill confidence script currently fails for missing agents-md-generator companion; keep this distinct from artifact gate and actual EDA results.
